claim: PSA: Do not go to JCPenney for headshot photos - Reddit
summary: Well first, don’t be like me and wait until the last minute to get your ERAS stuff taken care of. But second, do not go to JCPenney for headshot photos! I thought I would give JCPenney a try because multiple people on this subreddit have mentioned it is a good deal and gets you a sufficient headshot.
